card.name: Capital S starting a new sentence
card.fires_on: The single capital letter S when it begins a new sentence, line or section, so that the rest of the word (often a name like Sue, Sandy, Sergio or a label like SOURCES) comes next.

modes.label: Start of a name
modes.description: S opens a person's or storm's name at the start of a sentence or speaker line.
modes.example: Around Our House <<S>>ue has a great hobby and it is

modes.label: Start of a label or heading
modes.description: S opens an all-caps or short heading such as SOURCES, SOUNDBITES or Serves.
modes.example: OURCES: Video, contact information and more available at: http://www.prnewswire.com/broadcast/34919/consumer.html <<S>>OUNDBITES: * Courtney From H

card.writes: It favors word endings that continue an S-initial name or word, and suppresses common first names like Elizabeth and Maria.
card.plain: It fires on a lone capital S that starts a new sentence or line, before the rest of the word.
